Boundary Beach is the south Tsawwassen pocket on Boundary Bay beside the Canada–United States border at Point Roberts, in the City of Delta.
Centennial Beach, at 570 Boundary Bay Road, is the beach inside Boundary Bay Regional Park next to these homes.
The governing plan is the Delta Official Community Plan (OCP) 2024, Bylaw No. 8400, adopted July 8, 2024, with no Tsawwassen area-plan schedule; the former plan was Schedule D.1 under Bylaw No. 3950.
The pocket mixes older beach homes on Centennial Parkway and 66 Street with newer Southlands homes on Market Avenue and Southlands Drive.
Delta's Small-Scale Multi-Unit Housing (SSMUH) updates allow up to four units on single-detached and duplex lots, with City help for coach houses, garden suites and secondary suites.

blocks.text: Boundary Beach: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Foreshore homes face Hazard Development Permit Area SD3, which sets a 2.9 metre Geodetic Survey of Canada datum minimum floor level.
SD3 also sets a 2.3 metre minimum land surface elevation around construction and a 7.5 metre setback from the natural boundary of a tidal area.
The Province owns nearly all saltwater foreshore, and private moorage is held by lease or licence through FrontCounter BC.
Whether SD3 covers a specific lot is a parcel-level check; do not assume it from the street alone.

blocks.text: Boundary Beach: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: The shore sits behind the Boundary Bay dike, and the City is the diking authority.
Beach Grove Elementary, at 5955 17a Avenue, is the other elementary school on this side of Tsawwassen on the Ministry list.
The South Delta After-Hours Urgent and Primary Care Centre is at 1826 – 4949 Canoe Pass Way, per Fraser Health.
Delta Hospital, at 5800 Mountain View Boulevard in Ladner, is the nearest hospital on the Fraser Health pages.
Delta property taxes for 2026 were due July 2, 2026, with a 5% penalty after that date and a further 5% after September 2, 2026.
For 2026 the flat-rate utility total is $1,658 for a single-family home, billed annually at the end of February, with metered water and sewer billed quarterly where metered.
The City of Delta is a listed taxable area for the provincial Speculation and Vacancy Tax.
Route 601 is the bus link to Bridgeport Station on the Canada Line, with Boundary Bay trips via Boundary Bay Road.
The Dyke Trail in Boundary Bay Regional Park provides walking and cycling along the shore.

blocks.text: Boundary Beach: risks and due diligence

items.t: Check SD3 on the specific parcel before valuing a rebuild, because floor level and setback rules can change the build.
Verify foreshore tenure for any dock or moorage from the Province, not from listing text.
Confirm the dike and drainage context for the lot with the City.

faq.a: Boundary Bay Regional Park serves this pocket, with Centennial Beach at 570 Boundary Bay Road. Metro Vancouver lists the Dyke Trail, the Savannah and Raptor trails and Cammidge House in the park. The park is an internationally recognized Important Bird Area. Most of Centennial Beach is closed to dogs, with signed posts showing where.

faq.q: Which schools serve the beach address?
faq.a: South Park Elementary is at 735 Gilchrist Drive for Kindergarten to Grade 7. South Delta Secondary is at 750 53 Street for Grades 8 to 12. Check any other address in the locator.

faq.q: What flood rules affect a waterfront build?
faq.a: The SD3 foreshore rules affect a waterfront build through floor level, land elevation and setback. No habitable floor may sit below 2.9 metres datum. Land around construction must be at least 2.3 metres datum. No building may sit within 7.5 metres of the tidal natural boundary.

faq.q: Who owns the beach in front of a home?
faq.a: The Province owns nearly all saltwater foreshore, not the upland owner. Tenure for docks or moorage is by lease or licence only, through FrontCounter BC. Private moorage sits under a General Permission or Specific Permission. Value beach access on that tenure basis.

faq.q: What park and beach serve Boundary Beach?
faq.a: Boundary Bay Regional Park and Centennial Beach (570 Boundary Bay Rd, Metro Vancouver), with the Dyke Trail, the Savannah and Raptor trails and Cammidge House; the park is an internationally recognized Important Bird Area on the Pacific Flyway.

faq.q: Is Boundary Beach covered by published market statistics?
faq.a: No. SnapStats publishes no South Delta figures — its Delta coverage is North Delta only — so no Boundary Beach or Tsawwassen median, inventory or sales figure can be stated from the sources used here (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: What flood and foreshore rules apply to a waterfront home here?
faq.a: Hazard Development Permit Area SD3 (Boundary Bay Foreshore and the Southlands) sets a 2.9 m GSC datum minimum floor level, a 2.3 m minimum land surface elevation and a 7.5 m setback from the natural boundary of a tidal area, the shore sits behind the Boundary Bay dike maintained by the City of Delta, and the foreshore itself is provincial Crown land held by lease or licence.
